Priya (PM): Quick sync: we need to pick pilot scope for the Optimize toolkit (batching, prefix caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). Goal: lock by Friday.
Marco (Eng): Understood. Which ones are runtime-blocking vs control-plane only? I can give effort estimates after that.
Elena (ML): Quant recs need an eval harness and concordance guardrails. Propose alert threshold <=1% absolute drop.
Maya (CS): Customers rank quant recs highest, then caching, batching last. Fintech customer also needs audit trail and rollback controls.
Jamie (Design): Pilot UX should be read-only suggestions only. No auto-apply. Show rationale and confidence.
Priya (PM): Proposed triage axes: impact (tokens/$), risk (quality), effort, measurability. High impact + low risk -> pilot. Agree?
Sam (SRE): Observability is critical: emit tags for "recommendation_used", "cache_hit", and "quant_profile". Otherwise we can't attribute econ wins.
Marco (Eng): Draft minimal pilot scope: quant rec read-only for top 3 models (control-plane), prefix cache LRU + TTL + metrics, adaptive batching suggestion opt-in (no KV changes), eval-alert pipeline with grace window.
Elena (ML): For eval-alerts require N=2 consecutive failing runs before firing to reduce noise. Also attach example failing prompts.
Priya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: quant recs visible + 1 customer enrolled; caching shows >=5% token-savings or documented reason; batching shows >=10% cost improvement on batchable traffic; eval-alerts <=20% FP after grace window.
Maya (CS): I'll confirm anchor customers and get eval prompts. Customer A requires SOC2 clause before pilot.
Marco (Eng): Rough T-shirt: quant recs M, caching S, batching M, eval-alerts S. Note: KV changes would increase cost and require migration plan.
Priya (PM): Voting: react :one: quant-first, :two: caching, :three: batching, :four: eval-alerts. I'll draft PRD by Fri.
Jamie (Design): I'll mock the recommendation and alert card flows by Thu.
Sam (SRE): I'll publish telemetry schema by Tue.
Priya (PM): Thanks team. Reconvene Wed standup if blockers. :thumbsup:
